text:
Maria: Heads up — helm lint started failing on the gpu-scheduler chart in CI. Only when the values contain base64 blobs for secrets. :thinking:

CI Bot: [ci-redwood] pipeline #542 failed on chart-lint (helm lint). Logs: https://ci.redwood/542 (snippet below) :x:

CI Bot: ```
Error: YAML parse error on gpu-scheduler/templates/secret.yaml: found unexpected character '\u0000'
```

Maria: The weird part — `helm template` locally renders fine. It's only in the lint step (we run `helm lint --values test-values.yaml`).

Jonah: Are the values actually binary or are they base64 strings? Helm/Go yaml lib can choke if there are NULs after decoding or when someone writes unescaped control chars.

Maria: They're base64 strings but some engineering scripts used `--binary` when writing the file into the docker image, so the test-values file in the CI container has literal NULs. Locally I didn't hit it because my editor sanitized.

Sasha: Oof. Two options: sanitize upstream CI image step, or change chart to guard against unescaped values. For linting maybe we should quote the value in `values.schema.json` as `string` with `pattern`? Not sure helm lint cares.

Kevin: Another approach: on template side wrap secret data with `| quote` or `printf "%s"` inside the template to force proper escaping. Example: ```
data:
  config: {{ .Values.secretBlob | quote }}
```
That avoids raw NULs being interpreted in the YAML emitter.

Maria: Tried `| quote` — still got the same parse error during `helm lint` in CI. But `helm template` works locally.

Jonah: Could be the helm version in CI uses a different YAML emitter (libyaml vs go-yaml). What's `helm version` in CI?

CI Bot: CI runner info: helm v3.11.0 (bundled with libyaml v0.2.5) on alpine:3.18 

Sasha: Our dev machines are on helm v3.9.x. That explains divergence. We should pin the lint container to the same helm or add a quick preflight that normalizes values files (strip NULs).

Kevin: For chart resilience, consider using `toString` helper (sprig) + `nindent` so the renderer always gets a string: `{{ .Values.secretBlob | toString | quote }}`. That prevents binary blobs from breaking template rendering in weird runtimes.

Maria: Good call. I'll try `toString | quote` in a branch and push. If CI still fails we'll update the lint image.

Jonah: Also add a small unit test in `.github/workflows/chart-lint.yml` to `cat test-values.yaml | hexdump -C` before lint so we can catch binary files earlier. Short term hack but helpful.

InfraBot: Scheduled maintenance: reprovisioning lint runners next Tue 03/10 to align helm versions.

Maria: Pushed branch `fix/lint-quote-binary-blob` with the `toString | quote` change and updated test-values to include a base64-ish placeholder. CI rerun: https://ci.redwood/542 (will update)

CI Bot: Rerun finished: chart-lint passed ✅

Maria: Nice — merging the change. Follow-up task: open issue to pin lint image and add preflight normalizer.

Sasha: Filed ENG-2985 for image pin + normalizer.

Kevin: TL;DR for docs: when chart expects arbitrary binary-ish strings in values, template with `| toString | quote` and add schema `type: string` in `values.schema.json` to avoid schema coercion.

Maria: Thanks all :thumbsup:
